mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 3.0% signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates on equity cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of triggered instances, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly lower than the baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 3.4% signals tight labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting central bank hawkishness and reducing equity valuations over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20d returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 3.4%, or the return distribution in low-unemployment periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction starts above 1.6 million units signals strong household demand and confidence, which drives equity market optimism and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in less than 50% of triggered instances, or the average return in high-HOUST periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 104.0 indicates weakening manufacturing activity, which signals deteriorating corporate earnings momentum and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates negative 20d returns in less than 55% of triggered instances, or the return in low-INDPRO periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in both personal consumption expenditures and residential fixed investment signals robust aggregate demand, which increases corporate revenue expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 50% of instances where both PAYEMS and HOUST are rising, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the CPIAUCSL above 296.5 with a 12-month increase exceeding 3.5% signals accelerating inflation, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy, which reduces equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates negative 20d returns in less than 55% of triggered instances, or the return in high-inflation periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in employment growth and a decline in the unemployment rate signals strong labor market dynamics that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in less than 50% of instances where PAYEMS is rising and UNRATE is falling, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures above 680 billion dollars signals strong consumer demand, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in less than 55% of instances when RSAFS is above 680.0, or the average return in high-RSAFS periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).
